name: Discover it Student Cash Back Card

localized_names.en: Discover it Student Cash Back Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 6 months on purchases; 16.49% to 25.49% variable APR after that.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not stated on the product page. Page FAQ mentions checking for foreign transaction fees if traveling outside the U.S.

credit_required.notes: No credit score required to apply. Page states: 'No credit score required to apply.'

base_rate.description: Earn 1% cash back on all other purchases.

categories.label: 5% cash back rotating quarterly categories (activation required)

rewards.redemption_notes: Cashback Match: unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all cash back earned at end of first year, automatically. No limit to how much Discover will match.

benefits.title: Unlimited Cashback Match
benefits.description: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match. So you could turn $50 cash back to $100. Or you could turn $100 cash back to $200.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: You're never responsible for unauthorized purchases on your Discover Card.

benefits.title: No Credit Score Required to Apply
benefits.description: No credit score required to apply. We may use credit scores if available.

notes: Discover it Student Cash Back. No annual fee. No credit score required to apply. 5% cash back on rotating quarterly categories (activation required) up to quarterly maximum, 1% on all other purchases. 0% intro APR for 6 months, then 16.49%-25.49% variable. Cashback Match in first year. FX fee not stated on page.
